'''Ja'Ka Tar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he was considered an "enemy of the state" in the [[Eternal Empire]], and was wanted by the [[Overwatch]] for smuggling, murder of soldiers and government officials, arson and treason. His "wanted" holo-poster was displayed at the Overwatch, and by the time [[Kaliyo Djannis]] with the help of the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] [[Raid on the Overwatch|raided]] it, Twi'lek's location was still considered unknown.<ref name="kotfe 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ja'Ka Tar appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
